question: The value of (17 + 15) ÷ 2 - 11 + 16 × 4 - 28 + 13 (-16 + 13) is:
solution:
**Given:**

The value of (17 + 15) ÷ 2 - 11 + 16 × 4 - 28 + 13 (-16 + 13) is:

**Formula used:**

Order of operations (PEMDAS/BODMAS): Parentheses, Exponents, Multiplication and Division (from left to right), Addition and Subtraction (from left to right)

**Calculation:**

(17 + 15) ÷ 2 - 11 + 16 × 4 - 28 + 13 (-16 + 13)

⇒ 32 ÷ 2 - 11 + 16 × 4 - 28 + 13 (-3)

⇒ 16 - 11 + 64 - 28 + 13 (-3)

⇒ 16 - 11 + 64 - 28 - 39

⇒ 5 + 64 - 28 - 39

⇒ 69 - 28 - 39

⇒ 41 - 39

⇒ 2

**∴ The correct answer is option 3.**
